threat_event: Attackers disable or falsify lighting alarms through legacy RMUs
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 1,100 legacy RMUs on public IP addresses with shared credentials
likelihood_basis: EV-059 (about 1,100 legacy RMUs on public IP addresses with shared credentials); EV-060 (heartbeat monitoring)
existing_controls: Alarm center watches for missing heartbeats
treatment_plan: Move legacy RMUs to the private APN or replace them; device certificates

threat_event: Lighting alarms are lost when the shared service assurance platform is down or isolated
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No written fallback to daily observation; alarm tenant depends on the Carrier platform
likelihood_basis: EV-060 (no written fallback to daily observation); EV-040 (alarm tenant on the Carrier platform); EV-059 (vendor direct alerting on about 5,100 units)
existing_controls: Vendor direct alerting for about 5,100 newer units
treatment_plan: Written fallback procedure; standby ingestion route; include in failover test

threat_event: Cellular backhaul outage cuts off the legacy RMU fleet
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single cellular provider for legacy RMUs
likelihood_basis: EV-059 (single cellular provider for legacy RMUs); EV-071 (backhaul accounts)

threat_event: Hurricane damages lighting on many structures at once
affected_asset_or_process: Towers in Florida and the Gulf states
likelihood_basis: EV-059 (coastal tower concentration); EV-071 (lighting outages during storms)
treatment_plan: Pre-storm FAA contact plan; joint storm plan (GR-11)

threat_event: FAA reports or outage records are missed during an incident
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Records in spreadsheets; FAA steps not in the group IR plan
likelihood_basis: EV-060 (outage records in spreadsheets); EV-021 (FAA reports not in the group IR plan)
treatment_plan: Records in SYS-T2; P08 matrix row

threat_event: Tower controls are assumed but not operating
owner: Tower division security and compliance lead

threat_event: RMU or smart lock tampering goes undetected
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: RMU and lock logs not in the SIEM
likelihood_basis: EV-008 (RMU and lock logs not in the SIEM); EV-060 (heartbeat monitoring)

threat_event: Ransomware halts GIS and lease systems
likelihood_basis: EV-016 (shared identity and hub); EV-019 (immutable backups)
owner: Tower division security and compliance lead

threat_event: Lease management vendor breach exposes landowner taxpayer IDs and bank data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 11,800 landowners' data at one vendor
likelihood_basis: EV-061 (about 11,800 landowners' data at one vendor); EV-028 (vendor SOC 2 report)
treatment_plan: 24-hour incident notice term; tokenized bank data

threat_event: Business email compromise redirects landowner rent payments
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Bank change requests accepted by email
likelihood_basis: EV-061 (bank changes accepted by email with a second approver); EV-071 (attempts to change bank details)
treatment_plan: Callback verification to the number on file before any bank change

threat_event: Inspection imagery AI misses a structural defect
likelihood_basis: EV-031 (inspection imagery subscription); EV-071 (pilot on 800 towers)
treatment_plan: Engineer reviews a sample of unflagged images too (P10)

threat_event: Shared smart lock credentials let unauthorized people into compounds
likelihood_basis: EV-062 (crew members share credentials); EV-059 (cameras at about 2,400 sites)

threat_event: Fiber route maps leak and enable targeted cuts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Route maps shared with three divisions
likelihood_basis: EV-063 (route maps shared with three divisions under role-based access)
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Tower division security and compliance lead
owner: Tower division security and compliance lead

threat_event: Legacy RMUs that accept the default password are taken over
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 212 of 1,100 legacy RMUs accept the manufacturer's default web password (P07 test, 2026-08-19)
likelihood_basis: EV-T-IA5 (212 of 300 tested legacy RMUs accept the default web password, 2026-08-19); EV-059 (1,100 legacy RMUs on public IP addresses)
treatment_plan: Change passwords on all 212 units by 2026-09-30; block web administration from the internet; replace units
